occurrence_query.dedupe: Exact duplicate coordinates removed per taxon after DWCA download.
occurrence_query.filters: GBIF Download API DWCA with TAXON_KEY, HAS_COORDINATE=true, HAS_GEOSPATIAL_ISSUE=false, OCCURRENCE_STATUS=PRESENT; app study extent and coordinate uncertainty <=100km applied locally.

metadata.scientific_caveat: GBIF plant occurrences are sampling-biased context records and do not prove local host use or ecological availability for the butterfly.
